description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 13.03.2023 to 19.03.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for customs operations, specifically exercising powers vested by statute to determine currency exchange rates for customs purposes.
